name: ChatBot — Cast
description: Worlds, locations, and characters for the roleplay chat app. Canonical profiles carry appearance, personality, biography, and voice; the fields here carry only AI-specific guidance that should never pollute canon. Linked Markdown documents become the lore available to prompt building.

productionFields.label: Cast notes
productionFields.hint: Optional notes about this cast, shown only in the app's content screen.

entitySelections.label: Worlds
entitySelections.hint: The worlds conversations can be set in. Genre, tone, and setting come from the canonical world profile.

fields.label: AI style guide
fields.hint: Writing-style instructions for the AI narrator in this world. AI-only; not part of canon.

assetSets.label: Session background
assetSets.hint: Default backdrop behind conversations in this world.

entitySelections.label: Characters
entitySelections.hint: Characters available for conversations. Appearance, personality, backstory, and voice come from the canonical profile.

fields.label: Behavior rules
fields.hint: Hard rules the AI must follow when playing this character. AI-only.

fields.label: AI instructions
fields.hint: Optional extra guidance for the model (pacing, quirks, taboos). AI-only.

fields.label: Relationship to the user
fields.hint: Starting stance toward the user's persona, e.g. "childhood friend".

assetSets.label: Tile image
assetSets.hint: Small identifying tile for pickers and lists.

assetSets.label: Expression sprites
assetSets.hint: One image per expression. The neutral expression is used as the default sprite.

entitySelections.label: Locations
entitySelections.hint: Optional canonical locations scenes can take place in.
